name: Critical System Binary Integrity Violation
description: Detects modification or hash replacement of core system executables in System32 or /bin.
explanation: Direct binary replacement of system files indicates advanced persistence, rootkit installation, or Trojanized binaries.
investigation_steps: Compare binary SHA-256 with vendor-known good hashes.
Inspect file creation timestamp and owner permissions.
Review audit logs to identify which user/process modified the file.
